statement: (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) : ∑ v, G.degree v ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V * G.edgeFinset.card
closed: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3), ∑ v, G.degree v ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V * G.edgeFinset.card
informal: In a triangle-free graph on n vertices with e edges the sum of squared degrees is at most n * e (sum deg u + deg v ≤ n over the edges); this is the key step of Mantel's theorem. Promoted from Mathlib2.bld2_mantel_equality_regular_aux1 (also proved inline in bld_mantel_triangle_free); generalised to an arbitrary universe.
